purpose: Audit the official/institutional secondary-research sweep for Centru, Sud-Muntenia and Sud-Vest Oltenia without promoting project activity, funding supply, technology deployment or unread source listings as evidence of AI4WORK need prevalence.

promoted_source.title: Prognoza angajarilor pe termen scurt - Judetul Olt (eSPOR)
limitations: County-level Olt only; historical 2022 survey / 2023 forecast.
Not AI/digital-skills specific and not a prevalence measure for AI4WORK 2026.
The source internally reports 506 versus 504 respondents with hires in two tables; the discrepancy is preserved and not reconciled by assumption.
No Olt survey statistic is promoted to H1-H5.

fresh_follow_up_screening.title: Prognoza angajarilor pe termen scurt - Judetul Harghita anul 2023
fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: Official PDF readback reports 1,264 employer respondents from a 7,920-employer frame and 44,042 employees represented from 75,471 (58.44%). It is a historical non-AI employer forecast of the same eSPOR family as S39.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: It adds no materially stronger AI/digital-skills prevalence evidence than existing Centru sources; it remains a screened historical benchmark and adds zero H1-H5.

fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: An official activity report states that an eSPOR short-term forecast surveyed 1,207 employers, but the screened public artifact is an implementation/activity summary rather than an auditable findings table for AI/digital-skills need prevalence.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: Project activity/output counts are not used as evidence of need; the already promoted S38 Prahova survey remains the stronger direct-complementary employer source for Sud-Muntenia.

fresh_follow_up_screening.title: Prognoza angajarilor pe 2026 - Judetul Covasna
fresh_follow_up_screening.observed_fact: The official listing remains verified, but the 21,745,921-byte PDF still has no completed controlled content readback in the web PDF path.
fresh_follow_up_screening.reason: No internal statistic, methodology or need claim is inferred from a listing alone.

refresh_conclusion: S40 is promoted only as historical direct-complementary employer evidence for Sud-Vest Oltenia. It improves regional employer-side triangulation but adds zero H1-H5 and does not change numeric ranking. Centru and Sud-Muntenia were re-screened; no stronger new AI/digital-skills prevalence source was promoted. Project/supply activity remains excluded as evidence of need.
next_refresh_rule: Continue source-exact official/institutional screening, prioritising recent auditable adult/employer instruments that directly measure AI/digital-skills needs in the eligible populations. Preserve internal discrepancies rather than reconstructing them and never promote project activity or a document listing alone.

call_requirements_refresh.connected_mail_query_scope: after:2026/09/02 excluding spam/trash/GitHub; terms 367944, AI4WORK, OMIPE, MIPE, PEO, 1302, Anexa 4, eucons.ro, Claus, GDPR
